selection_data: All 75 paired short cells only; no round-2 long cells have been run.
selection_reason: Complete coverage, then lowest full-suite geometric-mean first-99 epochs among completed configurations. Beta2 0.95 was rejected at its predeclared screen, not evaluated on the full suite.
long_policy: If a new short winner is selected, run its 30 long cells once at original budgets. This is reuse of the already observed round-1 regression suite, not fresh holdout evidence. Never tune or reselect using its outcomes.
status: Interim constant-rate comparison; final selection waits for the user-requested schedule experiment.
